Registry and counting notes These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Results and verificationMethods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries alpha=1, omega=10/20, q0=(1,1/omega) and p0=0. Central probes retain the evaluated binary64 h and sin/cos coefficients without snapping to mathematical pi. Editorial clarification The central actual floating map remains unresolved; ideal-pi Jordan structure is not transferred to it. Results concern 64-step amplification and small fixed inputs, not a scanned resonance diagram, general stability or a universal long-time error theorem. Axes for trajectories, states, time or iterations do not represent physical spatial dimensions. Adopted numerical method Full-potential Verlet and a Strang impulse composition: half B kick, exact A flow, half B kick. A contains the fast oscillator and slow free drift; B contains the slow potential and the coupling.
